분리한 트랙을 구간별로 듣고 어울리는 악기를 골라 MIDI로 바꿔요. 먼: Listens to each separated track section by section, picks a fitting instrument and turns it into MIDI. Needs the instrument recognition add-on first (about 10 MB; the model, about 350 MB, downloads on first use).
트랙마다 어떤 악기 소리인지 알아보고 마디 단위 구간으로 나눈 뒤, 구간: Recognizes the instrument on each track, splits it into sections by bar, then plays each section's notes with MeloFi instruments and synth presets and compares their timbre with the original. Takes 1–3 minutes per song.

구간마다 MeloFi의 악기와 신스 프리셋이 그 구간의 음표를 직접 연주: For each section, MeloFi's instruments and synth presets play its notes and are compared with the original by harmonics, spectrum, envelope (attack and decay) and noise. The closest match is selected; compare by ear and change it if you like.

Try it yourself. The tour moves on when you do.
오른쪽 버튼을 누른 채 드래그: Drag with the right button held
소리 뒤에 잔향이 남아요: A tail of reverb follows the sound
Learn the layout of the workspace and the keys that open each window.
13개 강의로 첫 비트 작성부터 파일 내보내기까지 차근차근 안내해 드려요: 13 short lessons take you from your first beat to exporting a song. Each one starts with a short animation; do the highlighted step yourself and the tour moves on. The lessons use a new practice project, and the project you were working on is saved automatically.
왼쪽 위는 메뉴(파일·편집·추가·패턴·보기·옵션·도구·도움말), 그 옆은: Top left are the menus (File, Edit, Add, Patterns, View, Options, Tools, Help), then the PAT/SONG switch, play, stop and record, tempo (BPM) and the metronome. The icons on the right open the windows. Space plays and stops, L switches PAT/SONG.
악기와 드럼 소리가 한 줄씩 들어가는 곳이에요. 오른쪽 칸을 눌러 비트를: Each instrument and drum sound gets a row here. Click the steps on the right to program a beat; F6 brings you back at any time.
Alt+F8이나 ‘브라우저’ 버튼을 눌러 보세요. 왼쪽에 샘플과 루프를: Press Alt+F8 or the Browser button. The Browser opens on the left, where you find samples and loops to drag in.
Press Alt+F8 again to close the Browser.
Press F7 to open the Piano Roll, where you draw melodies and chords.
F5를 눌러 보세요. 패턴과 오디오를 시간 순서대로 배치해 곡을 완성하는: Press F5. The Playlist is where you arrange patterns and audio over time to build the song.
F9를 눌러 보세요. 채널별 음량과 이펙트를 조절하는 곳이에요. F8을: Press F9. The Mixer sets each channel's level and effects. F8 opens the plugin picker (instrument chooser).
버튼 위에 마우스를 올리면 메뉴 아래 힌트 바에 설명과 단축키가 표시돼요: Hover over a button and the hint bar under the menus shows what it does and its shortcut. Check it whenever something is new to you.
Next, you'll make your first beat in the Channel Rack.
채널 랙으로 비트 만들기: A beat in the Channel Rack
Program a one-bar beat with kick, clap and hi-hat.
You start from a basic project with kick, clap, hi-hat, snare and piano. A bar has 16 steps; four steps make one beat.
킥 트랙의 1, 5, 9, 13번째 칸을 눌러 보세요. 한 마디에 쿵 소: Click steps 1, 5, 9 and 13 on the kick row: four kicks to the bar, the classic dance rhythm.
Press Space to play, and again to stop.
Click steps 5 and 13 on the clap row to put claps on beats 2 and 4. You can change steps while it plays.
하이햇 줄을 누른 채 옆으로 드래그하면 여러 칸이 한꺼번에 켜져요. 6칸: Hold and drag across the hi-hat row to turn on several steps at once. Fill at least six.
칸을 우클릭하면 꺼져요. 우클릭한 채 옆으로 드래그하면 여러 칸을 한 번: Right-click a step to turn it off. Right-drag across steps to clear several at once.
Ctrl+K를 누르면 칸마다 벨로시티 막대가 나타나요. 하이햇 막대를 들: Ctrl+K shows a velocity bar for each step. Varying the hi-hat velocities makes the beat feel much more natural. Press it again to close.
BPM을 바꿔 보세요. 80 안팎은 느긋하고, 120~130은 댄스곡 빠: Change the BPM. Around 80 feels relaxed; 120–130 is dance tempo.
Next, you'll add a melody and chords in the Piano Roll.
피아노 롤로 멜로디: A melody in the Piano Roll
Draw notes and build a melody with scales and chords.
Click the piano channel's name to open its Piano Roll.
가로축은 시간, 세로축은 음높이예요. 빈 곳을 클릭하면 노트가 생성되고,: Time runs left to right, pitch bottom to top. Click an empty spot to add a note, drag its end to change the length, right-click to delete it.
도구 (P · B · D · T · C · E): Tools (P · B · D · T · C · E)
Draw(P), Paint(B), Delete(D), Mute(T), S: Draw (P), Paint (B), Delete (D), Mute (T), Slice (C), Select (E): one key switches tools. Press B for the Paint tool.
키와 스케일을 고르면 어울리는 음만 밝게 표시돼요. ‘C’와 ‘메이저’를: Choose a key and scale and the notes that fit are highlighted. Pick C and Major.
H를 누르거나 ‘Stamp’ 도구를 선택하면 클릭 한 번으로 코드 전체를: Press H or choose the Stamp tool to enter a whole chord with one click.
마디마다 다른 높이로 코드를 찍어 보세요. 1-6-4-5(도-라-파-솔): Stamp a chord on a different root in each bar. The I–vi–IV–V progression (C–A–F–G) is behind countless pop songs.
‘도구’ 메뉴의 Riff Machine은 코드 진행 → 아르페지오 → 그: Riff Machine in the Tools menu builds a riff step by step: chord progression, arpeggio, groove, variation. Alt+R (Randomize) generates random notes within the chosen scale. Arpeggiate (Alt+A), Strum (Alt+S) and Quantize (Ctrl+Alt+Q) are there too.
Other channels' notes show through as faint guides, which makes it easy to fit parts together. Alt+V turns them on and off.
Drag in loops and stack them across tracks.
‘MeloFi 루프’에서 장르를 골라 파트를 클릭하면 미리 들을 수 있어: In MeloFi Loops, pick a genre and click a part to preview it. Drum, bass, chord and melody loops are made in your project's key and tempo. You can also add your own sample folders.
루프를 플레이리스트로 끌어오면 오디오 클립, 채널 랙으로 끌어오면 샘플: Drop a loop on the Playlist for an audio clip, or on the Channel Rack for a sample channel. Dragging straight from File Explorer works too.
다른 파트도 ‘넣기’를 누르거나 끌어다 놓아 보세요. 루프가 빈 트랙에: Add other parts with Insert or by dragging them in. Each loop goes onto the next empty track.
Clips side by side on different Playlist (F5) tracks play together. Try a bass or synth loop over the drum loop.
다음은 장르만 고르면 바로 루프를 만들어 주는 Loop Starter예요: Next: Loop Starter, which builds loops from just a genre.
원하는 장르를 선택해 곡의 틀을 잡고, 마음에 들지 않는 파트만 교체해: Pick a genre to sketch a song, then swap out the parts you don't like.
‘파일’ 메뉴의 ‘Loop Starter…’에서 장르를 골라 보세요. 드: Choose a genre in File > Loop Starter…. Drum, bass, chord and melody loops are made in a random key and tempo and laid out in the Playlist.
Space를 눌러 들어 보세요. 마음에 들지 않으면 Loop Starte: Press Space to listen. Not your thing? Run Loop Starter again for a new key and tempo.
변경하고 싶은 파트의 클립 제목 줄을 우클릭하고 ‘루프 바꾸기 (셔플)’: Right-click the title bar of the part's clip and choose Shuffle loop. Only that part is replaced with another variation.
Next, you'll arrange a song in the Playlist.
Place patterns, then duplicate and slice them to build the song's structure.
Press B. Dragging paints the pattern over and over in a row.
트랙 하나를 왼쪽에서 오른쪽으로 끌어 패턴을 네 번 이상 이어 붙여 보세: Drag along a track from left to right to paint the pattern four times or more.
Select(E)로 여러 클립을 드래그하여 선택한 뒤 Ctrl+B를 누르: Drag with Select (E) to pick several clips, then press Ctrl+B to duplicate them right after. With the Draw tool, Ctrl+drag selects.
C로 클립을 분할하고, T로 원하는 클립만 뮤트해요. 우클릭하면 삭제되고: C slices clips and T mutes individual clips. Right-click deletes; right-clicking a clip's title bar opens its menu.
L을 눌러 SONG 모드로 바꾸면 플레이리스트 전체가 재생돼요. PAT: Press L to switch to SONG mode and play the whole Playlist. PAT mode loops only the current pattern.
Load instruments and synth presets and shape the sound.
‘+ 채널’ → ‘악기…’를 누르거나 F8을 누르면 플러그인 피커(악기: Click + Channel > Instrument… or press F8 to open the plugin picker, then choose an instrument you like.
플러그인 피커의 ‘MeloFi 신스 프리셋’에서 베이스·리드·패드·플럭·: Browse synth sounds by bass, lead, pad, pluck and FX under MeloFi synth presets in the plugin picker. Pick a preset, then tweak its parameters to taste.
채널 이름을 더블클릭하면 채널 설정 창이 열려요. 작업 중 항상 띄워 둘: Double-click a channel name to open its settings window, which can stay open while you work. It holds the envelope, filter and arpeggiator.
‘+ 채널’에는 직접 소리를 만드는 신시사이저와 외부 VST3 악기를 불: + Channel also offers a synthesizer you program yourself and a menu for loading VST3 instruments.
Next, you'll add effects in the Mixer.
Balance and clean up the mix with effects, sends and sidechain.
Press F9 to open the Mixer.
On the piano channel, choose Reverb from + Effect.
하단 노브를 위아래로 드래그해 수치를 조절해요. 더블클릭하면 초기값으로: Drag the knobs below up or down to change values. Double-click resets a knob to its default.
‘+ 믹서 트랙’으로 트랙을 만든 뒤 채널의 ‘+ 센드’로 소리를 보낼: Create a track with + Mixer track, then send a channel to it with + Send. A channel can have several sends.
베이스나 패드에 ‘사이드체인’ 이펙트를 걸고 ‘따라갈 채널’을 킥으로 지: Put a Sidechain effect on a bass or pad and set its source to the kick: the sound ducks every time the kick hits. That's the pumping sound of dance music.
Next: automation, values that change over time.
Make a knob move on its own as the song plays.
믹서(F9)에서 원하는 노브를 우클릭하고 ‘Create automatio: In the Mixer (F9), right-click a knob and choose Create automation clip.
플레이리스트에 오토메이션 클립이 생성되었어요. 클립 내부를 클릭해 포인트: An automation clip is now in the Playlist. Click inside it to add points and drag them to shape the curve.
‘+ 오토메이션’에서 볼륨·팬·이펙트 항목을 직접 골라 만들 수도 있어요: You can also create one from + Automation by choosing volume, pan or an effect parameter.
Next, you'll record a microphone or instrument.
Record audio from a microphone and correct its pitch.
Press F9 to open the Mixer.
녹음할 트랙의 ● 버튼을 눌러 녹음 대기 상태로 설정하세요. 버튼을 우클: Click ● on the track you want to record to arm it. Right-click the button to choose the input (microphone or audio interface).
R을 누르면 재생과 함께 녹음이 시작되고, 다시 누르면 정지돼요. 녹음된: Press R to start playback and recording, and again to stop. The recording lands in the Playlist as an audio clip.
실시간 보정은 트랙에 ‘Pitcher’ 이펙트를 추가하고 키와 스케일을: For live correction, add the Pitcher effect to the track and set the key and scale (a correction speed near 0 gives the Auto-Tune effect). For recorded vocals, use Edit pitch in Newtone from the clip menu to move notes and fix pitch and timing.
Next, you'll record from a MIDI keyboard.
Record your playing into a pattern and line it up with the beat.
MIDI 건반을 연결하면 바로 연주할 수 있어요. 건반이 없다면 Ctrl: Connect a MIDI keyboard and play right away. No keyboard? Press Ctrl+Shift+K for the on-screen keys.
Ctrl+M으로 메트로놈을 켜세요. Ctrl+P를 누르면 녹음 시작 전: Turn on the metronome with Ctrl+M. Ctrl+P adds a one-bar count-in before recording starts.
R을 누른 뒤 건반을 연주해 보세요. 연주한 노트가 현재 선택된 채널의: Press R and play. The notes are recorded into the selected channel's pattern.
박자가 맞지 않는 경우 피아노 롤에서 Ctrl+Alt+Q를 눌러 퀀타이즈: If the timing is off, press Ctrl+Alt+Q in the Piano Roll to quantize.
Next, you'll export the finished project.
Save the finished song as audio, MIDI or stems.
Ctrl+R은 WAV, Ctrl+Shift+R은 MP3, Ctrl+Shi: Ctrl+R exports WAV, Ctrl+Shift+R exports MP3 and Ctrl+Shift+M exports a MIDI file.
‘파일’ 메뉴의 ‘DAW로 보내기’는 채널별 스템 파일로 저장해 다른 작: File > Send to DAW saves a stem per channel to take into another DAW. There's also Export video.
Last, you'll make the workspace your own.
Fit the size, colors and window layout to the way you work.
‘보기’ 메뉴의 ‘화면 꾸미기…’에서 화면 크기, 강조 색, 트랙과 피아: In View > Customize…, change the scale, accent color and the row heights of tracks and the Piano Roll.
‘보기’ 메뉴나 탭 더블클릭으로 피아노 롤·플레이리스트·믹서를 독립된 플: From the View menu, or by double-clicking a tab, the Piano Roll, Playlist and Mixer can float as separate windows. Try Detach all (floating layout). The layout is kept the next time you start the app.
채널 랙 경계를 드래그해 너비를 조정하면 설정이 저장돼요. 피아노 롤과: Drag the Channel Rack's edge to set its width; it is remembered. Alt+scroll wheel changes the Piano Roll and Playlist row heights.
